Electrolux Professional AB is a publicly traded corporation listed on the Nasdaq Stockholm exchange (Large Cap) under the ticker symbol EPRO-B, following its spin-off and share distribution from AB Electrolux on March 23, 2020.

As an independent publicly traded group, the company's financial backing is sustained by commercial operations and market capitalization, recording total liabilities and shareholders' equity of SEK 13.0 billion as of December 31, 2025.

The company maintains access to institutional capital through major global asset management shareholders, with Nordea Investment Management AB holding 5.31% and Swedbank Robur Fonder AB holding 5.065% of the capital as of recent disclosures.
To secure debt-based financial backing, the company established a Medium Term Note (MTN) program and executed debt financing, issuing Loan 4 under its 2026 MTN Base Prospectus on August 26, 2026.
